title: Sluggish
summary: SLUG'GISH, adjective 1. Habitually idle and lazy; slothful; dull; inactive; as a sluggish man. 2.Slow; having little motion; as a sluggish river or stream. 3. Inert; inactive; having no power to move

inlines.v: SLUG'GISH, adjective 1. Habitually idle and lazy; slothful; dull; inactive; as a sluggish man. 2.Slow; having little motion; as a sluggish river or stream. 3. Inert; inactive; having no power to move itself. Matter is sluggish and inactive.
